title: Approximation classes for the anisotropic space-time finite element method. An almost characterization
summary: We study the approximation of $L_p$-functions, $p\in (0,\infty]$, on cylindrical space-time domains $Ω_T:=[0,T]\times Ω$, $0<T<\infty$, $Ω\subset \R^d$ Lipschitz, $d\in \mathbb{N}$, with respect to continuous anisotropic space-time finite elements on prismatic meshes. In particular, we propose a suitable refinement technique which creates (locally refined) prismatic meshes with sufficient smoothness and the desired anisotropy, and prove complexity estimates.
